55: def parse_ccmc_dat(path):

57:         [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []
58:     )
59:     with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
60:         for line in f:
61:             s = line.strip()
62:             if not s or s.startswith("#") or s.startswith("ENLIL"):
63:                 continue
64:             parts = s.split()
65:             if len(parts) >= 15:

67:                     mjd_val = float(parts[0])

70:                     r_au.append(vals[0])

73:                     n.append(vals[3])

76:                     vt.append(vals[6])
77:                     vn.append(vals[7])
78:                     br.append(vals[8])
79:                     bt.append(vals[9])
80:                     bn.append(vals[10])

82:                     bp.append(vals[12])

138: def compute_exact_parker_ode(r_grid, gamma=1.5):
139:     """Integrate the exact 1D steady spherical Parker/Weber-Davis ODE from r_in=0.10 AU to 2.40 AU."""
140:     CODE_V0_KMS = 100.0
141:     CODE_B0_NT = 45.8506
142:     CODE_T_SCALE_K = 6.0554e5
143:     GM_SUN_CODE = 0.088713
144:     OMEGA_SUN_CODE = 0.042914
145: 
146:     r_in = 0.10
147:     rho0 = 700.0
148:     vr0 = 400.0 / CODE_V0_KMS
149:     br0 = 300.0 / CODE_B0_NT
150:     T0 = 5.0e5 / CODE_T_SCALE_K
151:     p0 = rho0 * T0
152: 
153:     mflux = r_in * r_in * rho0 * vr0
154:     bflux = r_in * r_in * br0
155:     K_ent = p0 / (rho0 ** gamma)
156: 
157:     def rhs(r, y):
158:         vr = y[0]
159:         rho = mflux / (r * r * vr)
160:         p = K_ent * (rho ** gamma)
161:         cs2 = gamma * p / rho
162:         bph = -bflux * OMEGA_SUN_CODE / (r * vr)
163:         ca_ph2 = (bph * bph) / rho
164:         num = 2.0 * cs2 / r + ca_ph2 / r - GM_SUN_CODE / (r * r)
165:         den = vr - (cs2 + ca_ph2) / vr
166:         return [num / den]
167: 
168:     sol = solve_ivp(rhs, [r_in, r_grid[-1]], [vr0], t_eval=r_grid, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-11)
169:     vr = sol.y[0]
170:     rho = mflux / (r_grid * r_grid * vr)
171:     p = K_ent * (rho ** gamma)
172:     T_K = (p / rho) * CODE_T_SCALE_K
173:     br_nT = (bflux / (r_grid * r_grid)) * CODE_B0_NT
174:     bph_nT = -(bflux * OMEGA_SUN_CODE / (r_grid * vr)) * CODE_B0_NT
175:     return {
176:         "r_au": r_grid,
177:         "n_cm3": rho,
178:         "vr_kms": vr * CODE_V0_KMS,
179:         "Br_nT": br_nT,
180:         "Bph_nT": bph_nT,
181:         "T_K": T_K,
182:     }

def plot_mandated_3i_atlas_timeseries(pn_gtis, comet_dfs, run_summaries):
    """
    Generate Mandated Product (1):
    1D timeseries charts of the solar wind at 3I/ATLAS during the observation:
    - time vs number density (for protons and heavy ions)
    - time vs speed (heliocentric and comet-frame relative)
    - time vs flux (proton flux and heavy-ion SWCX flux, plus XMM EPIC-pn X-ray lightcurve comparison)
    """
    ballistic = pd.read_csv(SC_DIR / "mapped_flux.tsv", sep="\t")
    ccmc = np.load(PROC_DIR / "ccmc_extracted.npz")
    xray = pd.read_csv(SC_DIR / "lightcurve.tsv", sep="\t")
    xray["mjd"] = Time(xray["midpoint_utc"].astype(str).tolist(), format="isot", scale="utc").mjd

    c_m3 = comet_dfs["model3_assimilated"]
    c_m2 = comet_dfs["model2_wsa_cal"]
    c_m1 = comet_dfs["model1_ccmc"]
    c_mh = comet_dfs["model3_holdout_wind"]
    c_fine = comet_dfs["res_fine_224x48x240"]

    # Compute comet-frame relative speed & flux for CCMC ENLIL using exact comet radial/tangential velocity
    ccmc_mjd = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_mjd"]
    ccmc_n = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_n_cm3"]
    ccmc_vr = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_vr_kms"]
    ccmc_vt = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_vt_kms"]
    ccmc_vn = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_vn_kms"]
    ccmc_vmag = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_vmag_kms"]
    ccmc_flux_helio = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_flux_cm2s"]
    # 3I/ATLAS velocity in RTN at 1.873 AU: v_R = +43.13 km/s, v_T = -49.43 km/s, v_N = +2.17 km/s
    ccmc_vrel = np.sqrt((ccmc_vr - 43.13)**2 + (ccmc_vt - (-49.43))**2 + (ccmc_vn - 2.17)**2)
    ccmc_flux_rel = ccmc_n * ccmc_vrel * 1e5

    ens_keys = ["model3_assimilated", "res_fine_224x48x240", "res_med_120x24x120", "cfl_half_0175", "lat_domain_45deg", "phys_gamma_53", "phys_with_cmes"]
    n_min_ens = np.min([comet_dfs[k]["n_cm3"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    n_max_ens = np.max([comet_dfs[k]["n_cm3"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    v_min_ens = np.min([comet_dfs[k]["vmag_kms"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    v_max_ens = np.max([comet_dfs[k]["vmag_kms"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    vr_min_ens = np.min([comet_dfs[k]["vrel_comet_kms"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    vr_max_ens = np.max([comet_dfs[k]["vrel_comet_kms"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    f_min_ens = np.min([comet_dfs[k]["flux_rel_cm2s"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)
    f_max_ens = np.max([comet_dfs[k]["flux_rel_cm2s"].values for k in ens_keys], axis=0)

    t_mhd = Time(c_m3["mjd_utc"].values, format="mjd").to_datetime()
    t_ccmc = Time(ccmc_mjd, format="mjd").to_datetime()
    t_xray = Time(xray["mjd"].values, format="mjd").to_datetime()

    def decorate_obs_window(ax, show_gtis=True):
        ax.axvline(Time(MJD_PN_START, format="mjd").to_datetime(), color="#b15928", lw=1.3, ls="--", label="EPIC-pn Obs Start/End")
        ax.axvline(Time(MJD_PN_END, format="mjd").to_datetime(), color="#b15928", lw=1.3, ls="--")
        ax.axvline(Time(MJD_ALL_END, format="mjd").to_datetime(), color="#6a3d9a", lw=1.1, ls=":", label="All-Pointing End (17:22Z)")

                ts = Time(row["mjd_start"], format="mjd").to_datetime()
                te = Time(row["mjd_end"], format="mjd").to_datetime()
                ax.axvspan(ts, te, color="#ffd92f", alpha=0.28, label="Accepted EPIC-pn GTIs (21.36 ks)" if idx_g == 0 else None)

                Time("2025-12-05T12:00:00", format="isot").to_datetime())

    ccmc_mjd = ccmc["3I-Atlas1_mjd"]
